lead: LeBron James has built a public profile as an American basketball player, born on 30 December 1984 in Akron.
As of 2026, he is 41 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has represented Cleveland Cavaliers and Miami Heat and has 17 credited works on public record.
The sections that follow break down LeBron James's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: LeBron James — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: LeBron James was born on 30 December 1984 in Akron, and holds American nationality.
Public records name his father, Anthony McClelland and his mother, Gloria James.
He studied at St. Vincent–St. Mary High School and Buchtel High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: LeBron James — Career and Professional Work
paras: LeBron James works primarily as a basketball player, screenwriter and television actor.

On the team sheet, LeBron has been associated with Cleveland Cavaliers (from 2003 to 2010), Miami Heat (from 2010 to 2014), Cleveland Cavaliers (from 2014 to 2018) and Los Angeles Lakers (from 2018). He plays as a power forward.
He has taken part in 2012 Summer Olympics, 2008 Summer Olympics, 2004 Summer Olympics, 2007 FIBA Americas Championship and 2006 FIBA World Championship.

sections.heading: LeBron James — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for LeBron James circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a basketball player, screenwriter and television actor, team contracts, match fees, brand partnerships and sponsored social content.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
